title: Room 1.1 · Zombie (CR 1/4) · Moderate, 50 XP · cleared, untouched
headline: Three Fire Bolts and a natural 1 on Undead Fortitude: the zombie never got within reach.

bullets.label: The budget
bullets.text: floor 1 is built for a level 1 wizard, so Moderate here is 75 XP, a third of a level 3 Low fight.

bullets.label: The plan
bullets.text: a zombie moves 6 m a round and the rubble between rows 5 and 8 halves that, so he stood at the door and shot. Sleep does nothing to undead, so it stayed in the book.

bullets.label: The dice
bullets.text: the first Fire Bolt rolled a 1 for damage, then 7 and 8. The last one dropped it to 0 HP, and its Undead Fortitude save (DC 13) came up a natural 1.

bullets.label: Result
bullets.text: 20/20 HP, nothing lost. XP 900 → 950. The room's 5 GP go in his pocket. Searching it took one 10-minute turn: no other exits but the N archway at B1.

trace.text: Room 1.1, 6×18 m (A–D × 1–12), rubble across rows 5–8 (difficult terrain, half cover). Morten at B11 inside the S door; the Zombie at C3. Initiative: Morten 18, Zombie 15.
Fire Bolt hits (21 vs AC 8): 1 fire dmg. Zombie 15 → 14 HP.
The Zombie climbs into the rubble: C5, 6 sq away.
R2 Fire Bolt hits (22 vs AC 8): 7 fire dmg. Zombie 14 → 7 HP.
R2 The Zombie wades on through the rubble to C7, 4 sq away; the rubble gives it half cover (AC 10).
R3 Fire Bolt hits (23 vs AC 10): 8 fire dmg. Zombie 7 → 0 HP.
Undead Fortitude, CON save vs DC 13 (5 + 8 dmg): natural 1, fail. Zombie dead.

foes.name: Zombie
foes.notes: Undead Fortitude: at 0 HP, CON save DC 5 + the damage (not radiant or a crit) to drop to 1 HP instead; immune to poison; darkvision 18 m
